definition: Population standard deviation, divisor N; not sample standard deviation (N-1), RMS, or L2 norm.
rounding_policy: Clamp negative variance only within8ulps of max(rms^2,mean^2); larger negative values are errors. This is a local arithmetic allowance, not an upstream reduction error bound.
limitations: Derived from finite binary64 atlas summaries, not recomputed from original tensor values.
Cancellation may lose relative accuracy when variance is small compared with squared mean; nonnegative results are not guaranteed accurate to all displayed digits.
Input mean/RMS summaries inherit upstream chunked-reduction rounding; this supplement does not estimate or correct that error.
